description: For each requested pair of dated, scoped memory items decide contradicts | supersedes | refines | compatible | unrelated and which item supersedes.
changelog: v2: T6-15 rewritten as a same-day conflicting report (date-inversion wording was ambiguous in the blind pass); T6-21 C made an explicit detail of B's rotation

cases.rationale: Same prod database, B is an explicit later upgrade.

items.text: The Stork API runs on Postgres 15.
Stork API was upgraded to Postgres 16 last night.

cases.rationale: Upload limit vs a team's standup time: no shared subject.

items.text: Heron file service accepts uploads up to 200 MB.
Puffin ekibinin günlük toplantısı 09:15'te.

cases.rationale: B adds the shipper and batch window without changing A.

items.text: Falke logs are shipped to Loki.
Falke logs are shipped to Loki by promtail with a 5 s batch window.

cases.rationale: Different scopes (dev vs prod); both hold.

items.text: Kestrel uses a local SQLite file as its database.
Kestrel uses Postgres 16 as its database.

cases.rationale: Two same-day reports give different ship dates for the same release.

items.text: Otter release 2.3 shipped on Tuesday, 2026-04-07.
Otter release 2.3 shipped on Thursday, 2026-04-09.

cases.rationale: 30 s == 30000 ms: equivalent restatement in other units, not a change.

items.text: Lynx gateway request timeout: 30 s.
Lynx gateway request timeout is set to 30000 ms.

cases.rationale: Numeric near-miss 6432 vs 5432; B (German) is an explicit later change.

items.text: Wren connects to the database through pgbouncer on port 6432.
Wren: pgbouncer lauscht jetzt auf Port 5432, damit der App-Standard passt.

cases.rationale: Negation on the same day and scope; nothing says which replaced the other.

items.text: TLS certificate auto-renewal is enabled on the Ibis edge proxy.
Ibis edge proxy: certificate auto-renewal is NOT enabled; certificates are renewed by hand.

cases.rationale: Per-device settings on two different devices can both hold.

items.text: The memory wrapper on this device runs with a token budget of 1500.
The memory wrapper on this device runs with a token budget of 3000.

cases.rationale: B adds region, encryption and lifecycle to A's 'backups go to S3' (Turkish).

items.text: Martı servisi yedeklerini S3'e yazıyor.
Martı backups go to S3 in eu-central-1, encrypted with SSE-KMS, with a 30-day lifecycle rule.

cases.rationale: B explicitly drops 0731 and sets a new default later.

items.text: Librarian model candidate for HLMemo: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731.
V4 Flash 0731 is not viable since it was retired upstream; the default librarian becomes deepseek-v4.1-flash with reasoning disabled.

cases.rationale: Different scopes: production vs local dev.

items.text: HLMemo production does not publish the Postgres port; only Caddy listens on 80 and 443.
HLMemo's local compose stack publishes Postgres on 127.0.0.1:5432.

cases.rationale: Domain registration vs ranking constant: no shared subject.

items.text: HLMemo's domain was registered at the VPS provider's registrar and is renewal-locked.
HLMemo's rank fusion uses RRF with k = 60.

cases.rationale: B (German) is an explicit later change of the deploy branch.

items.text: Kranich deploys to production only from the 'release' branch.
Kranich deployt ab sofort direkt aus 'main'; der 'release'-Branch wird abgeschafft.

cases.rationale: Same day, same scope: one report says it was raised to 2 GiB today, the other says 1 GiB and unchanged; nothing establishes which replaced the other -> contradicts.

items.text: Gannet indexer memory limit in prod is now 2 GiB (raised from 1 GiB this morning).
Gannet indexer prod memory limit is 1 GiB; nobody has changed it this month.

cases.rationale: B qualifies A's archive rule with exemptions and reversibility; no conflict.

items.text: Decay archives volatile, unpinned items whose retention stays below 0.1 for three consecutive daily cycles.
Stable facts and lessons are exempt from decay archiving, and archived items can be restored.

cases.rationale: 200 MB == 0.2 GB, Turkish vs English: equivalent restatement.

items.text: Heron'un maksimum yükleme boyutu 200 MB.
Heron accepts uploads of up to 0.2 GB.

cases.rationale: Implicit change: a minimum of 4 is incompatible with a fixed 3; B is the later configuration.

items.text: stork-api in production runs a fixed 3 replicas.
stork-api production autoscaling: minReplicas 4, maxReplicas 10.

cases.rationale: B violates a standing invariant; it is not an intentional update of the rule.

items.text: Invariant: no Albatross service may store card numbers; payments are tokenized by the payment provider.
Albatross checkout stores the full card number in the orders table to support refunds.

cases.rationale: B reverses A's switch later.

items.text: HLMemo embeddings switch to gemini-embedding-2 through the cloud API.
Measured on the hybrid path, the switch did not pay off: HLMemo launches with the local e5-small embedder, and the cloud embedder becomes opt-in.

cases.rationale: B changes the rotation length later (supersedes A); C adds the handover time to B's two-week rotation without conflict (refines).

items.text: Puffin on-call rotates weekly.
Puffin switched to two-week on-call rotations.
Puffin's two-week on-call rotations hand over on Mondays at 10:00.

cases.rationale: A (Turkish, dev) and B (prod) are different scopes; C upgrades prod later.

items.text: Tern dev ortamında veritabanı olarak SQLite kullanılıyor.
Tern prod runs on Postgres 16.
Tern prod moved from Postgres 16 to Postgres 17.

cases.rationale: B later reverses the exclusion; C is about repository hosting.

items.text: DeepSeek's first-party API fails the EU privacy bar, so the librarian shortlist excludes DeepSeek.
Owner decision: cloud models are acceptable for all projects for now, so DeepSeek variants are candidates again.
The HLMemo repository is public on GitHub under the owner's personal account.

cases.rationale: B changes the fallback later; C is about the TLS edge.

items.text: When HLM_TEST_DSN is unset, the test suite falls back to the compose 'hlm' database.
The test fallback now uses a dedicated 'hlm_test' database, and any DSN that names 'hlm' is refused before truncation.
The public endpoint terminates TLS in Caddy with automatic certificates.

cases.rationale: B replaces 0.1 later; C narrows when the 0.9 trigram leg applies.

items.text: The trigram leg uses a pg_trgm word_similarity_threshold of 0.1.
The trigram threshold is set to 0.9: at 0.1 the GIN recheck scanned every chunk, and recall is the same at 0.7-0.9.
The trigram leg with its 0.9 threshold is used only for identifier-like query terms.

cases.rationale: A and B are different machines; C adds tooling detail to the same production OS.

items.text: The deploy rehearsal VM runs Ubuntu 24.04 with 2 vCPU and 8 GiB.
The production host runs Ubuntu 26.04 LTS on x86_64.
Production runs Ubuntu 26.04 LTS; the tooling was adapted to its sudo-rs and uutils coreutils.

cases.rationale: B (German) changes the admin locale later; C is an export job with no shared subject.

items.text: Kranich admin UI defaults to the en-US locale.
Standardsprache der Kranich-Admin-Oberfläche ist jetzt de-DE.
Kranich's nightly export job writes CSV files to the 'exports' bucket.

cases.rationale: B later adds a provider firewall; C gives a conflicting rule set for the same VM on the same day.

items.text: The production VPS has no provider-level firewall; all filtering happens in ufw on the host.
A provider firewall is now active on the production VM: inbound 22/tcp, 80/tcp, 443/tcp and 443/udp, everything else dropped.
The provider firewall on the production VM allows inbound 22/tcp only; web traffic arrives through a tunnel.

cases.rationale: B changes INFO to DEBUG, C (Turkish) reverts to INFO; A and C state the same value.

items.text: Sığırcık prod log seviyesi INFO.
Sığırcık prod log level switched to DEBUG to chase the refund bug.
Debug bitti; Sığırcık prod log seviyesi tekrar INFO.

cases.rationale: 15 s == 15000 ms; 1.5 s is a numeric near-miss conflict on the same day and scope.

items.text: Albatross checkout timeout: 15 s.
Albatross checkout timeout is 15000 ms.
Albatross checkout timeout is 1.5 s.
